description: This file defines the NationalityService class within the OrangeHRM administrative plugin. It provides functionality for managing nationalities, including retrieval, creation, deletion, and validation operations, utilizing a DAO layer and normalization traits.

classes.name: NationalityService
classes.description: Service class that manages nationality entities, providing CRUD operations, validation, and normalization functionalities.

methods.name: getNationalityDao
methods.description: Lazy initializes and retrieves the NationalityDao object.

methods.name: setNationalityDao
methods.description: Sets the NationalityDao object from outside, useful for dependency injection.

methods.name: getNationalityList
methods.description: Retrieves a list of nationalities based on search filter parameters.

methods.name: getNationalityCount
methods.description: Returns the count of nationalities matching the search criteria.

methods.name: saveNationality
methods.description: Persists a nationality entity to the database.

methods.name: getNationalityById
methods.description: Retrieves a nationality entity by its unique ID.

methods.name: getNationalityByName
methods.description: Retrieves a nationality by its name.

methods.name: deleteNationalities
methods.description: Deletes multiple nationalities identified by their IDs.

methods.name: isExistingNationalityName
methods.description: Checks if a nationality with the given name already exists.

methods.name: getNationalityArray
methods.description: Returns an array of normalized nationality data for use in other parts of the application.
